author: Porkyyy
body:
Hello, over the past month and a bit, vladthegreat100 has kept spamming my posts with comments such as "unblock me" and posting images of our Skype conversations.
I really don't want everyone reading what I discuss with him, so I'd like this post to be removed:https://avicus.net/forums/d8991cd70?page=6#reply248535

Also, if this isn't enough to give him a punishment, I'd like to know that he is at least warned to stop, as he is constantly doing these things.
Thank you.
